blocks.text: 1. CAPSTONE — The Night Eagle — “The midnight cry is upon us!” (Matt. 25:6)
2. THE WHITE EAGLE — “We have also a more sure word of prophecy — and the day star arise in your hearts.” (II Peter 1:19) — And Jesus said, “Surely I come quickly.” (Rev. 22:20)
3. “In the evening time there shall be light! We are in the latter times!”
